body:
15. A script `r7-place.sh <scratch-root> <viola> [--rehearse]`, in the shape of `scripts/r3-focus.sh` and
    `scripts/r2-open.sh`.
    - Its frame: `set -u`; a `trap` that closes what it opened on every exit path; `VIOLA_NAME` / `VIOLA_DIR` /
      `VIOLA_BIN` unset first (tests · decision/live-rig-clean-start). Its header states that it opens ONE terminal
      window and starts no claude.
    - **The stand-in**: a 0700 `/bin/sh` file named `claude` in a scratch bin dir put first on PATH. It answers
      `--version` alone with one fixed line, exits 0, and otherwise ignores the wrapper's leading arguments and
      sleeps. The CLI is therefore unverified, so the start writes no trust record and runs no automatic verify.
    - Preconditions, read first, each failure printing `r7: red precondition=<word>` and starting nothing:
      - the scratch root absent;
      - `foot` and `hyprctl` on PATH;
      - `hyprctl locked` reading `false`;
      - the stand-in's `--version` answered;
      - the build's hash printed right before the start (verification-harness 2026-10-20).
    - **The reading**:
      - Read `hyprctl -j monitors` and take the focused monitor's active workspace `A`.
      - Choose a target `N`: the lowest of 1–9 that is not `A` and that `hyprctl -j workspaces` lists with no window,
        else the lowest that is not `A`.
      - Run `<viola> --home <scratch>/home open r7place --workspace N --json -- claude`, its PATH holding the
        stand-in, and read its `placement`.
      - Read the monitors again: `A2`.
      - `active=unchanged` when `A2 == A`, `moved` when not, `unread` when either read failed.
    - **The close**: the opened instance's wrapper ended by TERM (its pid read from `snapshot.json`'s `data.pid`;
      verification-harness 2026-11-19), its foot window waited gone. The script dispatches no focus of its own.
    - Its one verdict line, from a closed set:
      - `r7: green placement=placed active=unchanged` only when both hold;
      - `r7: red placement=<word> active=<unchanged|moved|unread>` otherwise.
    - `--rehearse` runs the same steps over the fake `foot` and `hyprctl` (terminal mode) in a scratch bin dir with the
      same stand-in. It cannot reach the real compositor. Its verdict line comes first, then the last line
      `r7: rehearsed — not a live reading`, so its output is never a record the gated entry may take.
